question: 최근 14일 이내 TrackIn 된 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.TRACKINTIME, L.QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(day, -14, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())
pred_sql:
SELECT L.LOTID, CONVERT(date, L.TRACKINTIME) AS TRACKIN_DATE, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = PD.SITEID AND L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID
WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(day, -14, GETDATE())
AND (L.STATE IN ('RELEASED', 'PROCESSING') OR 1=1)
ORDER BY TRACKIN_DATE DESC
description: 최근 14 일 이내 TrackIn 된 LOT 목록과 제품명을 조회합니다. CIM_LOT 테이블의 TRACKINTIME 컬럼을 사용하여 날짜 필터링하고, PRODUCTDEFINITIONID 를 통해 제품명 (PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME) 을 JOIN 합니다.

gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.DUEDATE, L.QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.DUEDATE >= DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) AND L.DUEDATE < DATEADD(day, 30, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, L.GRADE AS 등급, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS 제품명 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()), L.DUEDATE) <= 30
description: 기준일 (약 1년 전 오늘) 부터 30 일 이내 납기일이 남은 LOT 와 해당 제품명을 조회합니다.

question: 수량이 0 초과 100 이하인 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘

question: 작업지시와 품목 구분명을 함께 보여줘

FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML ON PO.SITEID = ML.SITEID AND (ML.WORKORDERID IS NOT NULL OR ML.EQUIPMENTID IS NOT NULL)
LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND PO.SITEID = PD.SITEID

question: 30일 이내 만료 예정인 자재 LOT을 보여줘

question: 결함률이 0보다 큰 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.ORIGINALQTY, L.DEFECTQTY, CASE WHEN L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(L.DEFECTQTY AS float) / L.ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 결함률 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 AND L.DEFECTQTY > 0
pred_sql:
SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTNAME AS LOT_NAME, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = O.SITEID AND (L.PROCESSSEGMENTRULEID IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE P.PROCESSNODEID = L.PROCESSNODEID))
LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.MATERIALLOTNAME LIKE '%' + MD.DESCRIPTION + '%'
WHERE O.DELAYFLAG IN ('N', 'Y') AND O.FIRMFLAG IN ('N', 'Y')
AND (L.DEFECTQTY > 0 OR L.LOSSQTY > 0)
ORDER BY L.LOTNAME
description: 결함률이 0 보다 큰 LOT(불량 수량 또는 손실 수량이 존재) 과 해당 제품명을 조회합니다. 작업지시 지연/확정 여부는 필터링 조건으로 포함하며, 자재 정의 연결은 설명 필드를 기반으로 LEFT JOIN 처리했습니다.

pred_sql: SELECT L.LOTNAME AS 배치명, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AS PRODUCTDEFINITIONID, PDD.DESCRIPTION AS LOT제품명 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PDD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = PDD.SITEID AND L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PDD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID
description: 배치명과 제품명을 조회하는 SQL입니다.

question: LOT 자재 소비 내역에 자재명과 공정명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL R WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.MATERIALLOTID = ML.MATERIALLOTID AND R.SITEID = ML.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND R.SITEID = S.SITEID
pred_sql: SELECT L.LOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME AS 자재명, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME AS 공정명 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL RML WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = RML.LOTID AND L.SITEID = RML.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON RML.MATERIALLOTID = MD.MATERIALLOTID AND RML.SITEID = MD.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND L.SITEID = S.SITEID
description: CIM_LOT, CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL 을 기본으로 하여 자재 정의 및 공정 세그먼트 정보를 조인하여 LOT ID, 자재명, 공정명을 조회합니다.

question: 불량률 상위 10개 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.LOSSQTY, L.ORIGINALQTY, CASE WHEN L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(L.LOSSQTY AS float) / L.ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 불량률 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 ORDER BY 불량률 DESC
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTNAME AS 로트명, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AS 제품정의아이디, PPD.NAME AS 제품명 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.WORKORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTPROCESSREL PP WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.PROCESSDEFINITIONID = PP.PROCESSDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = PP.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSNODE PN WITH(NOLOCK) ON PP.PROCESSNODEID = PN.PROCESSNODEID AND L.SITEID = PN.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE (L.DEFECTQTY + 0 > 0 OR EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 DEFECTID FROM CIM_LOTDEFECT D WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE D.LOTID = L.LOTID)) ORDER BY COALESCE(L.DEFECTQTY, 0) DESC
description: 불량 수량이 있는 LOT 중 불량률이 가장 높은 상위 10 개를 추출하여 로트명, 제품정의아이디, 제품명을 조회합니다. JOIN 시 WITH(NOLOCK) 을 테이블 이름 뒤에 바로 배치하고, 존재하지 않는 컬럼 (PROCESSDEFINITIONID 등) 과 잘못된 alias 를 수정했습니다.

question: TrackIn 건수 상위 5개 설비와 설비명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 5 L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME, COUNT(*) AS TrackIn건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(month, -6, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY TrackIn건수 DESC
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 5 L.EQUIPMENTID AS EQUIPMENT_ID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME AS EQUIPMENT_NAME FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = E.SITEID AND L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID GROUP BY L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
description: TrackIn 건수 (LOT 수) 가 가장 많은 상위 5 개 설비와 해당 설비명을 조회합니다.

question: 지연 작업지시별 연결 LOT 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME, COUNT(L.LOTID) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTORDERID = L.PRODUCTORDERID AND O.SITEID = L.SITEID WHERE O.DELAYFLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME
pred_sql: SELECT PRODUCTORDERID AS 지연작업지시번호, COUNT(*) AS LOT개수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DELAYFLAG = 'Y' AND PRODUCTORDERID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PRODUCTORDERID
description: 지연 작업지시 (DELAYFLAG='Y') 에 연결된 LOT 개수를 제품별 집계
